sbp.label: Systolic blood pressure
sbp.help: The top number of a blood pressure reading.

tobacco.label: Cumulative tobacco use
tobacco.help: Total tobacco used over a lifetime, not per year.

ldl.label: LDL cholesterol
ldl.help: LDL ('bad') cholesterol. The dataset does not state the unit; values look like mmol/L.

adiposity.label: Adiposity
adiposity.help: A body-fat measure similar to BMI. Not precisely defined in the source dataset.

famhist.label: Family history of heart disease
famhist.help: Whether a close relative had ischaemic heart disease.

typea.label: Type A behavior score
typea.help: Score from the Bortner questionnaire (scale 12-84). 55 or more counted as Type A in the original study.

obesity.label: Body mass index (BMI)
obesity.help: Weight in kg divided by height in metres squared.

alcohol.label: Current alcohol consumption
alcohol.help: The dataset does not state the unit.

BMI.label: Body mass index (BMI)
BMI.help: Weight in kg divided by height in metres squared.

FamilyHistoryDiabetes.label: Family history of diabetes
FamilyHistoryDiabetes.help: Whether a close relative has diabetes.

SystolicBP.label: Systolic blood pressure
SystolicBP.help: The top number of a blood pressure reading.

DiastolicBP.label: Diastolic blood pressure
DiastolicBP.help: The bottom number of a blood pressure reading.
